content.short: Deri Protocol is an open-source trading protocol on BNB Chain and Arbitrum.
content.description: Deri Protocol is an open-source trading protocol operating on BNB Chain and Arbitrum. It provides a Web3-style Trading View interface with a variety of trading visualizations, enabling users to monitor price movements, chart patterns, and the performance of DeFi tokens. For developers, the project offers a native testnet to build and deploy demo contracts before deploying on the mainnet, giving a safe real-chain environment for testing ideas and workflows.
